infobox.title: ಗೌಪ್ಯತಾ ಸ್ಟಾಕ್
infobox.imageCaption: GL.iNet router ಜೊತೆ AdGuard Home running ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್-ವ್ಯಾಪಿ DNS ಫಿಲ್ಟರಿಂಗ್

lead:
ನನ್ನ **ಗೌಪ್ಯತಾ ಸ್ಟಾಕ್** is ಪದರಗಳ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಗೌಪ್ಯತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭದ್ರತಾ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ spanning OS hardening, ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ fingerprint resistance, hardware-level ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ filtering, self-hosted services, ಮತ್ತು planned email migration. It currently sits at approximately **85% ಪೂರ್ಣತೆ** — the main remaining gap is Gmail, which I haven't yet migrated to a ಗೌಪ್ಯತೆ-respecting provider.

I've built the entire stack on free ಮತ್ತು open source software, which connects philosophically to [[foss-coin|FOSS Coin]] ಮತ್ತು the broader FOSS-first approach documented in ನನ್ನ [[about|profile]]. Every layer is either already deployed or has a concrete plan ಗಾಗಿ deployment through ನನ್ನ [[homelab|Libre Cloud homelab]].

content.content:
The OS layer is the foundation. Running **Arch Linux via [[linux-setup|Omarchy]]** gives me the most control over what software is installed ಮತ್ತು what runs in the background. Hyprland Wayland tiling WM has minimal background services by design — compared to a typical desktop environment, the attack surface ಮತ್ತು telemetry footprint are dramatically reduced.

Key decisions I made at this layer:
- **Chromium removed** (telemetry) — replaced ಜೊತೆ LibreWolf
- **Spotify removed** (tracking) — no replacement
- **MAC address randomisation** enabled on all ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ interfaces
- **Fork control**: I maintain a personal ಗಿಟ್‌ಹಬ್ fork of Omarchy to selectively apply upstream changes on ನನ್ನ own terms

content.title: ನನ್ನ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಮಾದರಿ
content.content: Arch packages flow through the Arch pacman ecoವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ, not DHH's servers. Even using Omarchy, the underlying package signatures ಮತ್ತು build infrastructure remain the Arch Linux ಯೋಜನೆ's — not a third party's.

ನಾನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತೇನೆ **LibreWolf** — a Firefox fork ಜೊತೆ hardened anti-fingerprinting defaults applied out of the box. Key differences from stock Firefox that I care about:
- `resistFingerprinting` enabled by default — canvas, WebGL, audio, timezone, ಮತ್ತು font fingerprinting are all blocked
- No telemetry or crash reporting sent to Mozilla
- Stricter cookie defaults ಮತ್ತು cross-site isolation

**uBlock Origin** runs on top of LibreWolf in medium mode — blocking all third-party scripts ಮತ್ತು frames by default, ಜೊತೆ manual allowlist rules I've added over time ಗಾಗಿ sites that require scripts to function.

I also explored Firefox Multi-Account Containers ಗಾಗಿ session isolation per site category (banking in one container, social media in another, shopping in another).

content.title: ತಿಳಿದಿರುವ ವಿಶೇಷತೆ — ಡಾರ್ಕ್ ಥೀಮ್
content.content: LibreWolf's resistFingerprinting setting can break dark mode rendering on some sites. Fix: toggle resistFingerprinting off ಮತ್ತು on in about:config to restore correct theming. I've hit this a few times.
The DNS layer is the most technically layered part of ನನ್ನ stack — ನಾನು ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ multiple filtering ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆs at different levels:

rows.ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ: AdGuard Home on home subnet — blocks ads/malware ಗಾಗಿ all devices on ನನ್ನ home ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್
Ads + Trackers + Malware filtering on ನನ್ನ laptop ಮತ್ತು phone
ಯೋಜಿತ — will encrypt traffic from device to homelab exit node

content.title: ಕಾಲೇಜು WiFi ನಿರ್ಬಂಧ
content.content: SonicWALL SSL inspection on the college WiFi blocks pacman package downloads. ನನ್ನ workaround: mobile hotspot ಗಾಗಿ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ updates on campus.

rows.ಸ್ಥಿತಿ: ❌ ಬಾಕಿ — ನನ್ನ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂತರ. Custom domain contact@lingadevaru.in active.
✅ Live — no fingerprinting, no Google Analytics on any site I own
